$comment: Defaults for ai-review (one reviewer). Data, not code: a slug that is gone is a one-line fix here. ai-review stops before spending when the slug is not in the live OpenRouter catalog. Override per run with --model or AI_REVIEW_MODEL, or in ~/.config/ai-review/config.json (keys: model, timeoutMs, budgetUsd, confirmThresholdUsd, reasoningEffort, providerSort, maxOutputTokens, expectedOutputTokens). expectedOutputTokens are mean output tokens per review from 51 earlier council runs with reasoning effort medium (2026-10-01 to 2026-11-02); the model's own entry wins, else reasoningDefault for a model that supports reasoning, else nonReasoningDefault. They only move the cost estimate; the hard cap uses maxOutputTokens.
